description: This file defines the interface for ARCv2 architecture-specific interrupt handling in the Zephyr RTOS, including function declarations, macros for connecting and configuring interrupts, and inline functions for managing interrupt locking.

methods.name: arch_irq_is_enabled
methods.description: Checks if a specific IRQ line is enabled.

methods.name: z_irq_priority_set
methods.description: Sets the priority and flags for a specific IRQ.

methods.name: arch_isr_direct_header
methods.description: Inline function to handle ISR entry tracing.

methods.name: arch_isr_direct_footer
methods.description: Inline function to handle ISR exit tracing and clear interrupt.

methods.name: arch_irq_lock
methods.description: Disables all interrupts on the local CPU, returning a lock key.

methods.name: arch_irq_unlock
methods.description: Re-enables interrupts using the provided lock key.

methods.name: arch_irq_unlocked
methods.description: Checks if interrupts are unlocked based on the lock key.
